about.zh: 拼电路板：机器人在每一格上跑它
about.en: wiring a board the robot runs on every cell

about.zh: 亲手填表：每个地点的路线数
about.en: filling the table by hand: the routes to every place

about.zh: 一条条找出所有路线
about.en: tracing every route one by one

about.zh: 连线不交叉：两串字相同的字母连起来
about.en: lines that never cross between equal letters of two strings

about.zh: 找反例：画两条路线，落进同一个格子
about.en: finding the counterexample: two routes into one cell

about.zh: 顺着价值画出箭头
about.en: drawing the arrows along the values

about.zh: 一条条剪掉图里的缝
about.en: cutting seams out of a picture one by one

about.zh: 棋盘城市：只往右或往下走，每格可以有石头、体力或金币
about.en: the grid city: right or down only, a cell may hold a rock, energy or coins

about.zh: 棋盘城市，每格存「是 / 否」：能不能走到这里
about.en: the grid city holding yes / no: can a route get here

about.zh: 两堆石子：(a, b) 是两堆各剩几颗，存轮到的人能不能赢
about.en: two piles of stones: (a, b) the stones left, holding whether the player to move wins

about.zh: 铺草坪：一块地上有树，找最大的空正方形
about.en: a lawn to lay: a field with trees, the biggest open square

about.zh: 一段楼梯：一次上一级或两级，坏台阶踩不得
about.en: a flight of stairs: one or two steps at a time, broken steps not to be stood on

about.zh: 一堆石子：一次拿一颗或两颗，拿走最后一颗的赢
about.en: a pile of stones: take one or two, whoever takes the last wins

about.zh: 凑零钱：每格是一个钱数，扫描臂退回每种硬币
about.en: making change: a cell is an amount, the sweep arm steps back by every coin

about.zh: 切词：一串字母切成词典里的词，每块有代价
about.en: cutting a string into dictionary words, each part at a cost

about.zh: 一排房子，每家三个格子：没偷、偷了、最多
about.en: a row of houses, three cells a house: skipped, robbed, most so far

about.zh: 环形的街：第一家和最后一家相邻
about.en: a street in a ring: the first house and the last are neighbours

about.zh: 一排房子，每格是到这一家为止的总数
about.en: a row of houses, each cell the total so far

about.zh: 一排柱子：以这一根结尾，最长连几根越来越高
about.en: a row of posts: the longest rising run ending on this one

about.zh: 每天的收支：以这一天结尾的一段最多赚多少
about.en: daily gains: the best run of days ending today

about.zh: 有钥匙和门的迷宫，状态记住的每组钥匙是一层
about.en: a maze of keys and doors, one layer for every set of keys the state remembers

about.zh: 过河的青蛙：每块石头写着往回能跳多远
about.en: a frog crossing a river: each stone says how far back a jump reaches

about.zh: 股价：每天三种状态，空手、持有、刚卖掉
about.en: share prices: three states a day, flat, holding, just sold

about.zh: 对齐表：一个词在上面，一个词在左边
about.en: an alignment table: one word along the top, one down the left

about.zh: 局部对齐：两串字最像的一段
about.en: local alignment: the most alike stretch of two strings

about.zh: 背包表：行是物品，列是容量
about.en: the knapsack table: rows are items, columns capacities

about.zh: 压成一行的背包：只留一行，原地改写
about.en: the knapsack in one row, rewritten in place

about.zh: 区间表：一段 i..j 的答案，切点扫一遍
about.en: the interval table: the answer for a run i..j, every split point swept

about.zh: 格子世界：宝藏、陷阱和墙，扫到不再变
about.en: the grid world: treasure, traps and walls, scanned until it settles

about.zh: 给句子标词性：每一列一个词，每一行一种词性
about.en: tagging a sentence: a word a column, a part of speech a row

about.zh: 一张图：每格的能量，找一条最不起眼的缝
about.en: a picture: each cell’s energy, the least noticeable seam

about.zh: 小方：视野 3×3
about.en: Boxy: a 3×3 view

about.zh: 远望：视野 5×5，看得见表头，会换方向扫
about.en: Farsight: a 5×5 view, the table’s headings, other scan orders

about.zh: 长臂：视野 5×5，伸缩臂够到任意远
about.en: Longarm: a 5×5 view, a telescopic arm

about.zh: 扫帚：扫描臂一次扫过一整段
about.en: Broom: a sweep arm over a whole run

about.zh: 千层：同时站在很多层上，探针探到另一层
about.en: Layercake: many layers at once, a probe to another

about.zh: 回环：一轮一轮扫到不再变
about.en: Loop: scans in rounds until nothing changes

about.zh: 棋盘：R 行 C 列，箭头往右往下（或按 moves），个别格子另写
about.en: a grid of R × C with arrows right and down (or by moves), some cells written apart

about.zh: 一小块示意电路：上面是输入，中间是元件，下面是输出
about.en: a little circuit: inputs on top, parts in rows, outputs at the bottom

about.zh: 机器人 3×3 的视野：每格的值，亮起的是读的格子
about.en: the robot’s 3×3 view: what each cell holds, the ones read lit

about.zh: 输入元件上点了这个传感器
about.en: an input card reads this sensor

about.zh: 这个传感器读了，还接出了线
about.en: this sensor is read and wired on

about.zh: 板上有这种元件（可以再说它的数值）
about.en: the board has a part of this type (and this value)

about.zh: 一种元件直接接进另一种元件
about.en: a part of one type wired straight into a part of another

about.zh: 公共子序列表倒推出的路线和连线
about.en: the walk back through a common-subsequence table, and its matched letters

about.zh: 局部对齐从最大的一格倒推到 0
about.en: local alignment walked back from its best cell to a 0

about.zh: 从最底一行最小的格子倒推的缝
about.en: the seam walked back from the smallest cell of the bottom row

about.zh: 通过后：表格里藏着的连线
about.en: once passed: the lines hidden in the table

about.zh: 通过后：倒推出的改法
about.en: once passed: the edits traced back

about.zh: 全部通过后：候选词按步数排
about.en: once every test passes: the candidates by number of steps

about.zh: 通过后：最像的一段
about.en: once passed: the most alike stretch

about.zh: 通过后：倒推出的标法（测试有 note 时加一句）
about.en: once passed: the tagging traced back (and the test’s note)

about.zh: 通过后：倒推出的装法
about.en: once passed: the packing traced back

about.zh: 物品一览，正在改写的那件亮起
about.en: the items, the one being rewritten lit

about.zh: 词典（和每个词的代价）
about.en: the dictionary (and what each word costs)

about.zh: 反例：一家一格时，两段历史落进同一个格子
about.en: the counterexample: with one cell a house, two histories land in one cell

about.zh: 压成一行时，改写方向错了会把一件物品放两次
about.en: in one row, rewriting the wrong way packs an item twice

about.zh: 读这一关的一个传感器，名字随它
about.en: a sensor of the level, named as it is

about.zh: 第 n 条来路（a、b、c、d）：一个传感器，或板上一个只属于这一关的输入
about.en: way in n (a, b, c, d): a sensor, or an input of the board of its own

about.zh: 「起点」：一个是 / 否传感器
about.en: “start”: a yes / no sensor
